fields.r: Daily adjusted-close stock returns, decimal units; rows=date, columns=security
fields.security_ids: Stable local security identifiers, in stock-column order
fields.symbols: Source vendor tickers, in stock-column order

excess_returns: x = r - rf[:, None]; verified byte-identical to the original x
first_return_row: Undefined because the price panel has no preceding close; not used in PCA/training
split_indices: Zero-based indices into the full returns.npz date axis; stop is exclusive

data_audit.identity_limit: Local stable security IDs; issuer keys without CIK are name-based. Provider historical lineage, not a certified point-in-time security master.
data_audit.survivorship_bias: Survival and data availability through Nov 2026; current capitalization-weight preference; future complete-history selection. Not historical top-500 or survivorship-free.
data_audit.return_convention: Yahoo adjusted-close ratios, with action/identity audit and no clipping; unexplained corporate-action discontinuities excluded before strategy fitting. Report backward dividend-adjustment convention.
data_audit.inherited_source_uncertainty: Single-vendor revised histories; internally reconciled action data do not guarantee externally perfect total returns.

original_configuration.universe_policy: Current IWB equity holdings, USD, United States, ordinary/common shares (REIT common allowed); rank unrounded fund market value descending, ticker ascending for ties; take first 500 passing integrity review.
original_configuration.timing: stylized decision/execution close t-1, total return ending close t
original_configuration.missing_payoff: stop affected series; never zero-fill or exclude retrospectively
original_configuration.diagnostic: first 750 envelope rows: 30 context + 720 outcomes; next 250 validation; no selection
original_configuration.user_scope_revision: Option 1 explicitly authorized: fixed 500 long-history survivors; retain 2011-2025 and original strategy settings.
original_configuration.fallback_pool: If fewer than 500 pass IWB, append current IWV eligible common equities in decreasing fund market value, skipping duplicates. No strategy performance observed.
original_configuration.history_requirement: Complete daily usable prices from 2005-10-03 through 2025-12-31, including all exchange sessions; no imputed returns.
original_configuration.selection_bias: Survival and data availability through Nov 2026; current capitalization-weight preference; future complete-history selection. Not historical top-500 or survivorship-free.
original_configuration.return_convention: Yahoo adjusted-close ratios, with action/identity audit and no clipping; unexplained corporate-action discontinuities excluded before strategy fitting. Report backward dividend-adjustment convention.
original_configuration.quality_rule: Missing/nonpositive/nonfinite quotes or invalid issuer/class lineage fail; extreme moves prompt evidence review, never automatic magnitude-based deletion; unresolved action-adjustment defects fail the security, not individual dates.
